ex.en: I bought a few eggs and a little milk.
ex.zh: 我買了幾顆蛋和一點牛奶。

ex.en: An egg should cook for at least 5 minutes.
I can't eat raw eggs; they must be cooked.
ex.zh: 我不能吃生蛋，一定要煮熟。

egg.en: an oval object laid by a hen or other bird, often eaten as food

ex.en: Losing the game in front of his friends really hurt his ego.
ex.zh: 在朋友面前輸了比賽，讓他的自尊心很受傷。

ex.en: His big ego makes it hard for him to admit mistakes.
ex.zh: 他太自負了，很難承認自己的錯誤。

ego.en: your feeling of how important or good you are

ex.en: Egypt is famous for its ancient pyramids.
ex.zh: 埃及以古老的金字塔聞名。

ex.en: The Nile River flows through Egypt.
We visited an Egyptian museum full of ancient treasures.
ex.zh: 我們參觀了一間收藏滿滿古代珍寶的埃及博物館。

ex.en: The Egyptian pyramids attract millions of tourists every year.
ex.zh: 埃及的金字塔每年吸引數百萬名遊客。

ex.en: My neighbor is an Egyptian who moved here ten years ago.
ex.zh: 我的鄰居是十年前搬來的埃及人。

ex.en: Many Egyptians live along the banks of the Nile River.
ex.zh: 許多埃及人住在尼羅河沿岸。
